title: ION Trade Resource Schema Pack v1
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 for the ION trade/resource/v1 schema pack. Root resolves to IONTradeResource, which inherits directly from Beckn RetailResource and combines generic trade fields with explicitly marked Indonesia-specific fields. Release 1 constraints are expressed by this standalone schema and its included release artifacts.

LocalisedText.title: LocalisedText
LocalisedText.description: Language-keyed text object for multilingual content. The 'id' key carries Bahasa Indonesia text and is always required. The 'en' key carries English text and is required for cross-border patterns.

en.description: English text value. Required for cross-border pattern.

IONTradeResource.title: IONTradeResource
IONTradeResource.description:
ION Trade sector resource attributes. Inherits from RetailResource v2.1 (schema.beckn.io) via allOf, which provides the core retail fields (resourceStructure, variants, images, availability, physical, packaged goods, age restriction, country of origin, etc.).
This schema adds fields that are useful for retail networks in general, plus Indonesia-specific regulatory and compliance fields. Properties specific to Indonesia are identified by x-attr-ion-layer: ion.

menuCategory.description: Menu or category section this resource belongs to. Used by food service and marketplace providers to group resources for display. Drives display order and grouping in BAP interfaces.

sequence.description: Display order of this category relative to others.

menuCategory.x-ion-condition: Required for food and beverage providers

preparationTime.description: ISO 8601 duration. Time from order confirmation to item ready for pickup or dispatch. Used for SLA computation and estimated delivery time display to the consumer. Applicable to made-to-order food, custom-built products, and services with lead times.
preparationTime.x-ion-condition: Required for food, beverage and made-to-order items

food.description: Packaged food product attributes for filtering and regulatory compliance. Use for FMCG packaged food, grocery products, bottled beverages, packaged meal kits, snacks, and confectionery sold from warehouse stock. Do not use for restaurant or cloud kitchen menu items — those use MenuItem in the Hospitality sector (hospitality/menu-item/v1). Detailed nutritional information and ingredient lists belong in Descriptor.longDesc for agent readability.

spiceLevel.description: Spiciness level of the food item. Free-text to accommodate regional descriptors (e.g. "Pedas Sedang", "Level 3", "Extra Hot").

netQuantityDeclaration.description: Declared net quantity of the fresh produce.

food.x-ion-condition: Required for food and beverage resources

preparation.description: Preparation, storage, and shelf-life instructions for the resource. Applicable to food, beverage, perishable, and made-to-order products. Detailed cooking instructions and usage guides belong in Descriptor.longDesc.

storage.example: Simpan di tempat sejuk dan kering

preparation.x-ion-condition: Required for food, beverage and perishable products

fashion.description: Fashion and apparel attributes for filtering and size guidance. Structured fields are limited to values that participate in deterministic filtering (gender, size) or regulatory compliance (fabricComposition under SNI). Descriptive attributes such as fitType, sleeveType, collarType, occasion, pattern, and careInstructions belong in Descriptor.longDesc as natural-language prose — AI agents extract richer meaning from prose than from closed enums.
fashion.x-ion-condition: Required for fashion and apparel products

electronics.description: Consumer electronics technical specifications for filtering and comparison. Structured fields are limited to values used in deterministic filtering (osType, connectivity) or regulatory compliance (energyRating, wattage). Descriptive specifications such as RAM, ROM, screen size, camera resolution, CPU, and battery capacity belong in Descriptor.longDesc — multimodal agents extract these from linked product datasheets and images in Descriptor.docs[] and Descriptor.mediaFile[] with higher fidelity than typed fields.
electronics.x-ion-condition: Required for electronics and appliance products

beauty.description: Beauty and personal care product attributes for filtering and regulatory compliance. concern and ingredient are descriptive fields — include them in Descriptor.longDesc for richer agent-readable content. Structured fields below are for filtering and compliance.
beauty.x-ion-condition: Required for beauty and personal care products

agritech.description: Agricultural and fresh produce attributes. Covers harvest dates, produce grade, pesticide declarations, and unit of measure for weight-sold products. Represent organic certification through regulatory.credentials.

scheme.description: Grading standard or authority under which the grade is assigned.

unitOfMeasure.description: Declared net quantity of the fresh produce.

agritech.x-ion-condition: Required for agritech and fresh produce

pharmacy.description: Pharmaceutical and over-the-counter medicine attributes. Covers prescription requirements, dosage form, active ingredients, and cold chain requirements. Applicable to prescription drugs, OTC medicines, and medical devices sold through ION.

dosageForm.description: Pharmaceutical dosage form. Suggested values cover common forms; other values are permitted as pharmaceutical forms evolve.

pharmacy.x-ion-condition: Required for pharmaceutical and OTC medicine

installation.description: Installation service information for products that require professional setup. Applicable to large appliances, heavy furniture, HVAC systems, and any product where the seller offers or requires installation.

notes.example: Memerlukan instalasi profesional. Membutuhkan arus 220V khusus.

installation.x-ion-condition: Required for appliances and furniture needing installation

usage.description: Usage constraints and compatibility information for the resource. Covers indoor/outdoor restrictions and compatibility with other products or infrastructure requirements.

warranty.x-ion-regulatory: UU 8/1999 tentang Perlindungan Konsumen Pasal 25; PP 36/2023
warranty.x-ion-condition: Required for electronics, appliances, consumer durables

crc.description: ION Catalogue Resource Category code classifying this resource within the ION item taxonomy and signaling how a CN may present and discover the resource. Release 1 does not publish a normative CRC registry; values such as TRC-fashion and TRC-electronics are informative examples for future registry work.

regulatory.description: Indonesian regulatory registrations and food safety declarations for the resource. Covers BPOM (food, medicine, cosmetics), MUI halal certification, SNI standards compliance, SP-PIRT for home-industry food, KEMENKES health product registration, and SIUP business licence references. All registration schemes are governed by Indonesian regulatory authorities.

scheme.description: BPOM_MD: domestic food/medicine/cosmetic BPOM registration. BPOM_ML: imported product BPOM registration. BPOM_TR: traditional medicine BPOM registration. MUI_HALAL: MUI halal certification. SNI: Standar Nasional Indonesia certification. SP_PIRT: home-industry food production permit (Sertifikat Produksi Pangan IRT). KEMENKES: health product registration from Ministry of Health. SIUP: business trading licence reference.

url.description: URL to publicly verify the registration.

nutrition.description: Structured nutritional information per serving or per 100g. Used for regulatory compliance display and consumer filtering (e.g. low-calorie, high-protein product discovery).

backImage.description: Back-of-pack statutory label image URL. Required for products subject to PerBPOM 31/2018 label display requirements.

regionOfOrigin.description: ISO 3166-2 sub-national region code for geographic indication products. Required when the product claims origin-protected status under Indonesian geographical indication law (e.g. Kopi Gayo from Aceh: ID-AC, Beras Cianjur from West Java: ID-JB). Supporting geographic-indication evidence should be supplied through the inherited credentials property.
regionOfOrigin.x-ion-regulatory: UU 20/2016 tentang Merek dan Indikasi Geografis
regionOfOrigin.x-ion-condition: Required when product claims Geographic Indication status

digital.description: Digital goods attributes specific to Indonesian digital commerce. Required when resourceTangibility is DIGITAL_VOUCHER, DIGITAL_TOP_UP, or DIGITAL_SUBSCRIPTION. Covers Indonesian-specific digital product categories: mobile pulsa and data packages (Telkomsel, XL, Indosat, Tri, Smartfren), electricity tokens (PLN), water bills (PDAM), tax payments (PBB), BPJS health insurance payments, and e-wallet top-ups. Game voucher categories cover popular titles in the Indonesian market (Mobile Legends, Free Fire, Valorant, Genshin Impact).

operatorOrIssuer.description: Issuing operator or brand. For MOBILE_PULSA: TELKOMSEL, XL, INDOSAT, TRI, SMARTFREN. For ELECTRICITY_TOKEN: PLN. For GAME_VOUCHER: Moonton, Garena, Riot, miHoYo etc.

deliveryMethod.description: PUSH_TO_TARGET: delivered directly to consumer account (pulsa to phone number, PLN token to meter number, in-game currency to game account). CODE_TO_BUYER: redemption code sent to buyer for later use. ACCOUNT_CREDIT: credited to buyer wallet or account. QR_VOUCHER: scannable QR redeemable at merchant point.

redemptionUrl.description: URL for redemption (streaming service activation, game code page).

expiryAfterPurchase.description: ISO 8601 duration — how long the voucher is valid from purchase date.

refundable.description: Whether the digital good is refundable. Most pulsa and top-up products are non-refundable once delivered to the target. Vouchers may be refundable if unredeemed.

cancellable.description: Whether cancellation is possible before delivery is initiated.

digital.x-ion-condition: Required when resourceTangibility IN [DIGITAL_VOUCHER, DIGITAL_TOP_UP, DIGITAL_SUBSCRIPTION]

dataResidency.description: Data residency requirement for this resource under Indonesian Personal Data Protection Law (UU 27/2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi). DOMESTIC_ONLY means all PII and transaction data associated with this resource must be processed and stored within Indonesia. BAPs with foreign data processing infrastructure must refuse transactions for DOMESTIC_ONLY resources. Required for pharmacy, health data, financial services, and regulated biometric product categories.
dataResidency.x-ion-regulatory: UU 27/2022 tentang Pelindungan Data Pribadi (PDP Law)
dataResidency.x-ion-condition: Required for pharmacy, health-data, and financial-services categories
